summary: 36 units reviewed: 6 errors, 28 minor. Errors: unit 13 (ā+abl. 'until' rendered 'since', bracketed words in Hindi), unit 35 (bracket in Hindi), plant identification in Hindi (नीम, हल्दी), यक्ष्मा for yakṣman. Common minor: English lowercase kapha/pitta against the fixed Kapha/Pitta renderings; uncorrected misprints left in w; gram labels. Draft is otherwise careful and honest on confidence. Regrouping: 4+5 (one elliptical sentence), 6-8 (one long sentence), 12-14 (13 and 14 continue 12), 33-35 (one passage); optional.
glossary_suggestions: kapha/pitta/vāta: capitalise in English (Kapha, Pitta, Vāta); inside compounds like raktapitta keep lowercase
praseka: gloss "flow, trickling"; do not add "of saliva"
harita-pāṇḍu: fix one pair in both languages, e.g. "green and pale" / हरे और पाण्डु (पीला-सा)
kaṣāya / kvātha / niryūha: all currently "decoction"; decide whether to keep the three apart
Hindi: never use plant common names (नीम, हल्दी): keep निम्ब, हरिद्रा; use यक्ष्मन् not यक्ष्मा
avacārayet / pāyayet / lehayet: fix literal verbs (administer / cause to drink / cause to lick)
